![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/69517e814dae28db96c64a662ce97b5fc40ea10355cb5a02561a0d12e1a3f845.png)

A math teacher asked his students how many hours of sleep they had the
night before a test. The information he received is summarized in the scatter plot above.

Given that none of the points overlap, which of the following statements are true?

- Only one student obtained a score of $90.$
- Only one student slept for $6$ hours.
- None of the students obtained a score lower than $75.$
worked_solution:
Let's examine our scatter plot.

- Statement I is true. The scatter plot has only one dot whose vertical coordinate equals $90,$ namely, $(7,90).$ This means that only one student obtained a score of $90.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/ef915015fa9c7685f45f26ee9cd2c10dfce5a4253aed22b6ea2ea57f0c3c26e2.png)

    

- Statement II is false. The scatter plot has two dots whose horizontal coordinate equals $6,$ namely, $(6,80)$ and $(6,85).$ This means that two students had  $6$ hours of sleep.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/3139ca71a780b76ca7355ddd119d6502f1cd390d67064db3a4a57801e33f2917.png)

- Statement III is false. From the scatter plot, three students obtained a score lower than  $75.$  Those students are represented by the three dots below the horizontal line.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/a675a94a9183a86d221bb2199dae38f9f55b9f91dff9868320b0b8f4d38b3fe9.png)

Therefore, the correct answer is "I only."
